Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics

Interface CosmeticsService

public interface CosmeticsService
The cosmetics each player owns, per category, and the one they chose in each.

Ownership is stored with the rest of the player's data, so a database shared by several servers shares it too. Every change works for offline players, applies to the data as stored now - which another server may have changed - and completes on the main thread. Online players' cosmetics are also cached, read as they join; getOwnership(java.util.UUID, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticCategory) answers from that cache.

Changes complete exceptionally while storage is unavailable, including while Zentrix runs on its in-memory stand-in for a database it could not reach; check isAvailable() first. A change that altered anything fires CosmeticOwnershipChangeEvent. 


 CosmeticsService cosmetics = ZentrixAPI.get().getCosmeticsService();
 cosmetics.grant(playerId, CosmeticCategory.GLIDERS, List.of("phoenix"))
     .thenAccept(change -> {
         if (change.changed()) {
             // unlocked
         }
     });
Since:
1.8.0

    • grant

      @NotNull @NotNull CompletableFuture<CosmeticChange> grant(@NotNull @NotNull UUID playerId, @NotNull @NotNull CosmeticCategory category, @NotNull @NotNull Collection<String> ids)
      Grants cosmetics permanently. Ones already owned permanently are left as they are; ones owned for a limited time become permanent.

    • grantTimed

      @NotNull default @NotNull CompletableFuture<CosmeticChange> grantTimed(@NotNull @NotNull UUID playerId, @NotNull @NotNull CosmeticCategory category, @NotNull @NotNull Collection<String> ids, @NotNull @NotNull Duration duration)
      Grants cosmetics for a limited time, such as a glider for seven days.

      A cosmetic the player does not own is granted until duration from now. One they already own for a limited time keeps its remaining time with duration added. One they own permanently is left as it is: a timed grant never shortens a permanent one.

      When the time runs out the cosmetic is taken away on its own, even while the player is offline or the server is restarting, and on every server sharing the database. A selection of it falls back to the server's default, and CosmeticOwnershipChangeEvent fires with CosmeticOwnershipChangeEvent.Cause.EXPIRED.

      Parameters:
      duration - how long to grant them for; must be positive
      Returns:
      completes on the main thread with the change
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the duration is zero or negative
      Since:
      1.9.0

    • select

      @NotNull @NotNull CompletableFuture<CosmeticChange> select(@NotNull @NotNull UUID playerId, @NotNull @NotNull CosmeticCategory category, @Nullable @Nullable String id)
      Chooses a player's cosmetic: one they own as stored now, or null for the server's default. Choosing one they do not own changes nothing. Unlike a player's own choice in the cosmetics menu, this does not fire CosmeticSelectEvent.
